grid.formula: lat step = km/111.32; lon step = km/(111.32*cos(rowCenterLat))

encoding.overview: uint16 raw/100 + uint8 bestSpecies + uint8 diversity
encoding.species: uint16 raw/100 + uint16 quality/100 + uint16 goodShare/1000

notes: BDL polygons are fetched once into reusable 0.25-degree gzip cache tiles.
Cell forest area is clipped geometrically in EPSG:2180; unlike v223, a polygon crossing a cell edge is not counted with its full sub_area in every touched cell.
No weather/season/observations are included; this remains static national habitat potential.
